name: Frame Window Recorder
description: 240-TPS frame-window analyzer with xdBot replay capture, duplicate-input filtering, colored outlined markers and sound cues.

max-shift.name: Max probe shift
max-shift.description: Maximum number of 240-TPS frames to test early and late for each input.

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases
analyze-releases.description: Also measure release timing windows. Presses only is recommended for the reference-style counter.

inject-offset.name: Replay inject offset
inject-offset.description: 240-TPS replay offset. Leave at 0 when capturing xdBot at 240 TPS.

validation-frames.name: Validation horizon
validation-frames.description: How many 240-TPS ticks a shifted input must survive. Tests stop before the next press when it is closer.

next-input-slack.name: Next input slack
next-input-slack.description: Stops a probe this many 240-TPS ticks before the next press so later inputs are not blamed on the current one.
